answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds. Each agent locks tokens behind a unique, verified proof-of-personhood, and rewards accrue only to bonded identities. A sybil attacker must fund and bond every fake identity separately, so the cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Think of a comet streaking over a meadow at night: one lantern reveals it, but forging thousands of lanterns to fake the sky costs far more than the light is worth. Operator sa0039 applies this at e9CpZhQRKw.
